subject: maths
question: The volume and height of a cylinder are 8470 cm³ and 2.2 cm, respectively. Find the radius (in cm) of the cylinder. Use pi = (22)/(7)
solution:
**Given:**

Volume of the cylinder = 8470 cm³

Height of the cylinder = 2.2 cm

Use π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cylinder = π r² h

**Calculation:**

Volume = π r² h

8470 = 22/7 × r2 × 2.2

⇒ r2 = {8470 × 7}/{22 × 2.2}

⇒ r2 = {59290}/{48.4}

⇒ r2 = 1225

⇒ r = √1225

⇒ r = 35

**The radius of the cylinder is 35 cm.**
